scripts.release:check: bun scripts/check-release.ts && bun run build:packages && bun scripts/check-npm-packages.ts
scripts.build:packages: bun run --filter mmd-contracts build && bun run --filter mmd-engine build && bun run --filter mmd-renderer build
scripts.dev: bun run build:packages && bun run --parallel --filter 'mmd-demo-*' dev
scripts.test: bun run build:packages && bun run --workspaces --if-present test
scripts.typecheck: bun run build:packages && bun run --workspaces --if-present typecheck
scripts.build: bun run build:packages && bun run --filter 'mmd-demo-*' build
